motion.name: pulse-ring
motion.purpose: Single next-action aura on the advance control; one element at a time, 10px spread over a 1.8s cycle.

motion.name: reduced-motion-fallback
motion.purpose: Under reduced motion the aura becomes a static heavier border and all transitions are disabled.

body.purpose: Explanations and hints at base size with loose rhythm and a comfortable measure.

display.purpose: Top-level plate titles and ledger headings.

label.purpose: Legends, hints, mission summaries, and status lines.

mono-measure.purpose: Readouts, metrics, table numerals, numeric entries, and plate tags with tabular figures.

micro.purpose: Mono tags, plate captions, and small registration labels; never body text.

donts: Don't use dark neon starfields, glow, gradients-as-content, or shadows for resting surfaces.
Don't use generic gray card grids or dense hostile-brand packing; keep rows calm and tabular.
Don't let stamp red or amber wander into decoration; red is for verdicts, amber for residuals and caution.
Don't invent new radii, new hues, or color-only states outside this ledger.
Don't place more than one pulse aura at once, and never animate it under reduced motion.
dos: Do keep grounds bright: paper pages, white plates, ink text, one blue for the model.
Do pair every encoding with legend plus text plus shape, never color alone.
Do keep numerals tabular and right-aligned in tables, metrics, and entries.
Do keep plates flat with a single hairline border and corner ticks; use washes for emphasis.
Do give every control a generous touch height (44px) with a visible label and a thick focus ring (3px).
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground with faint ruled lines and ink-black tabular figures
One restrained signal blue reserved for the model line and next action
Flat hairline plates with corner registration ticks and mono tags
Ledger rows and instrument strips, calm and tabular, closed by stamps
Legend plus text plus shape for every state, never color alone
Imagination is labeled where it appears: banner chips and amber '상상도 · 가상' tags, never stamp red.
narrative.northStar: 낮의 관측기록 콘솔 (The Daytime Observation Ledger)
narrative.overview:
The Daytime Observation Ledger is a bright daytime bench, not a night-sky cinema. Warm paper grounds every figure, ink-black tabular numerals carry measurement, and a single restrained blue draws only the model line and the next action. Density stays calm and tabular, with generous line rhythm (1.6) and thin rules separating ledger rows.

Plates feel like registered instruments: white grounds, thin borders, small corner ticks, and mono tags. Verdicts arrive as rotated rubber stamps in reserved red, caution rests in amber washes, and agreement rests in quiet leaf washes. Every encoding pairs line, text, and shape, never color alone.

rules.body: Signal blue marks the model and one next action at a time; nothing else borrows it.
rules.name: The One Signal Rule

rules.body: Stamp red appears only on verdicts, destructive outlines, and negative washes.
rules.name: The Verdict Reserve Rule

rules.body: Every state pairs legend plus text plus shape; dashed, dotted, and solid line styles stay distinct without hue.
rules.name: The Never Color-Only Rule

rules.body: Every measure, metric, table numeral, and numeric entry uses tabular figures so digits never jitter.
rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule

rules.body: Headings stay tight (1.3) with slight negative tracking (-0.02em); body prose stays loose (1.6).
rules.name: The Tight Headline Rule

rules.body: The two-band grid becomes one stacked column at the stack point (900px); visuals precede controls in the stack.
rules.name: The Stack At Narrow Rule

rules.body: Wide figures and tables scroll inside their plates; the page never gains horizontal scroll at narrow widths (320px).
rules.name: The No Page Push Rule

rules.body: Surfaces rest flat; no resting shadows anywhere in the system.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule

rules.body: Separation uses a border or a shadow, never both; this system chooses the border (1px).
rules.name: The Border Or Shadow Rule

rules.body: Instrument plates carry opposing corner ticks; they read as bench figures, not floating cards.
rules.name: The Registration Tick Rule

rules.body: Only step tokens and the small update link use the pill (999px); everything else stays squared.
rules.name: The Pill For Steps Rule

rules.body: At most one action carries the pulse aura at a time; reduced motion always swaps it for a static border (3px).
rules.name: The One Aura Rule

rules.body: Interactive controls keep a minimum height (44px); labels stay visible, never placeholder-only.
rules.name: The Generous Touch Rule
